name: G8 T3 W03 Part 2 - Check and improve your app
description: Check and improve your app. 2 words. Required: Flashcards and Fill in Blank. Read the Spark with the same name. Use this part in its Technology class.

words.definition: A check to find out whether something works.
words.example: We test the app by choosing a lunch and checking the order message.

words.definition: Information about work that helps someone improve it.
words.example: The feedback says the app should show the chosen lunch.
